remarks: Charming and updated 4BR/2BA Colonial in Stamford's desirable Hubbard Heights neighborhood! This sun-filled home blends 1920s character with thoughtful updates including fresh interior paint, new crown molding, and refinished hardwood floors. The renovated kitchen features high-end custom cabinetry, honed granite counters, and stainless steel appliances. Both full baths are remodeled with marble and designer fixtures. Smart home features include smart thermostats, Yale keyless entry, smart light switches, SimpliSafe security, and remote blinds in the living room. Extensive electrical upgrades include recessed lighting, updated fixtures, bedroom ceiling lights, and garage wiring with a smart opener. A Level 2 EV charger is also installed. The walk-up attic is fully insulated with heat and A/C, offering expansion potential. Enjoy a sunny front porch and spacious back deck overlooking your yard filled with perennial plantings. Close to Metro-North, I-95, downtown, parks, and shopping. Move-in ready and full of charm-don't miss it!
